subject: Scoped evidence request: SCIM reconciliation + role-owner proof for SOC 2
summary: External SOC 2 auditor requested SCIM delta logs, SAML assertion samples, and a role-owner map. Internal team validated available artifacts, flagged a short service-account delta gap in early May, and uploaded redacted artifacts to a shared Drive folder. Auditor asked for a brief retention statement and a canonical SAML sample for their evidence bundle.
messages:
From: Tina Ramos <tina.ramos@novamed.com>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.inference>
Cc: security@novamed.com
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Scoped evidence request: SCIM reconciliation + role-owner proof for SOC 2

Hi Mateo,

We're working through the NovaMed SOC 2 in-take with our auditor (Evan Clarke at Independent Audit Co.). They asked that we collect a scoped set of IAM artifacts for the period 2027-06-01 to 2027-07-25 to validate provisioning and least-privilege rollout. Specifically they requested: 

- SCIM delta export (full diffs / add/remove) for all user and group changes
- SAML assertion samples for interactive logins (time-based samples, not full logs)
- Role-owner mapping (spreadsheet tying roles -> owner -> created/last-modified)
- Notes on retention policy for auth logs and SCIM deltas

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide those artifacts and if there are any planned redactions or PII handling steps we should be aware of? Also please indicate estimated delivery (preferred within 3 business days). Evan has asked for a Drive link or SFTP; attaching the auditor intake checklist for reference.

Thanks,
Tina Ramos
IT Compliance Manager
NovaMed Health

[Attachment: auditor-intake-checklist.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

From: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.inference>
To: Tina Ramos <tina.ramos@novamed.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scoped evidence request: SCIM reconciliation + role-owner proof for SOC 2

Hi Tina — thanks for the detailed list and the checklist.

Short answer: yes, we can provide the requested artifacts for the date range you specified. Planned delivery details below.

What we'll deliver (redacted where appropriate):
- scim-delta-2027-06-to-2027-07.csv — CSV with add/remove/change events, user_id pseudonymized, timestamps in UTC (Attachment stub)
- role-ownership-2027-07.xlsx — role -> owner -> last_modified sheet, owners are internal email aliases (we will not disclose personal phone numbers)
- saml-assertion-sample.txt — three canonical assertion samples (interactive login, re-auth, service-to-service) with headers preserved; PII redacted
- Brief retention note: auth logs retained 365 days; SCIM deltas stored for 730 days per policy (see short note below).

Timeline: we will upload a redacted evidence bundle to a shared Drive folder within 48 hours (target: 2027-07-31 17:00 PDT). If you prefer SFTP, we can provide a temporary bucket and credential exchange (let us know).

Heads-up: Marissa will own the artifact extraction and redaction; Ben will validate role-owner provenance for exports. There is one small gap we discovered during pre-checks (service-account delta missing for 2027-05-03 — 2027-05-05 window due to a rotated logging agent). We will include a short explanatory note and compensating evidence (rotation ticket and snapshot) as part of the bundle.

Delivering team:
Mateo Alvarez
Account Lead, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

[Attachment planned: scim-delta-2027-06-to-2027-07.csv (csv) – to be uploaded to Drive]

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.inference>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scoped evidence request: SCIM reconciliation + role-owner proof for SOC 2

Mateo / Ben — jumping in with the extraction status.

I ran the SCIM delta job and pushed a redacted CSV to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cexample

What I included:
- scim-delta-2027-06-to-2027-07.csv (pseudonymized user IDs, event_type, timestamp_utc, source, actor)
- role-ownership-2027-07.xlsx (roles, owner_alias, created_at, last_modified)
- saml-assertion-sample.txt (3 samples, timestamps and non-PII values preserved)
- rotation-ticket-20270504.pdf (ticket stub showing logging agent rotation)

Gap note: the SCIM delta job shows a missing patch between 2027-05-03 and 2027-05-05 for entries originating from the internal logging agent (root cause: ephemeral ingestion instance was rotated and a short-lived queue drained to the agent's local buffer). We do have the fallback snapshot and the rotation ticket attached. Auditor guidance: we recommend accepting the compensating evidence (rotation ticket + snapshot) for that small window.

Retention note (short):
- Auth logs: 365 days (event index retained; full raw session assertions trimmed to 90 days unless flagged)
- SCIM deltas: 730 days (full diffs stored, pseudonymized in export)

Ben — can you validate the role-owner tracking for the highlighted admin and service roles in the spreadsheet (rows flagged with COMMENT)?

Marissa Cole
Senior Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Evan Clarke <evan.clarke@independentaudit.co>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tina Ramos <tina.ramos@novamed.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scoped evidence request: SCIM reconciliation + role-owner proof for SOC 2

Thanks Mateo / Marissa — the folder link looks good and the artifacts are in scope. A few small follow-ups before we close the evidence loop: 

1) For the SAML assertion sample: can you provide one canonical raw assertion (with subject NameID redacted to pseudonym) and a short line-by-line explanation of the assertion fields included? That helps our reviewers quickly validate mapping to the control narrative.

2) For the retention note: please add a one-paragraph statement (signed by your security lead) summarizing the retention policy and exception handling (e.g., short gaps like the May rotated agent).

3) We'll accept redacted exports. Please ensure the role-ownership spreadsheet includes an audit trail column (who last attested and when). If you can add that before end of day Pacific, we can mark this evidence closed.

If you prefer, we can ingest the Drive bundle directly — otherwise an sftp link would also work.

Evan Clarke
Senior Auditor
Independent Audit Co.
